component.name: Zcode
component.summary: A simple, native code editor for GNOME

description.p: Zcode is a small, fast code editor for the GNOME desktop, written in Zig on top of GTK 4, libadwaita and GtkSourceView. It aims to stay simple and native: a collapsible project sidebar, syntax-highlighted editing and an integrated terminal, all following the GNOME Human Interface Guidelines.

ul.li: Collapsible project file tree with git status
Syntax highlighting via GtkSourceView and tree-sitter
Find a file in the project by name, find and replace in the file
Integrated terminal that follows the system style
Automatic light/dark mode and selectable editor themes
LSP-backed completion, hover, go to definition and formatting

screenshot.caption: Editing a project with the sidebar open

ul.li: Tree-sitter highlighting for Zig, Go, Rust, C, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript and Markdown
Language-server completion, hover, go to definition, diagnostics and formatting
Project sidebar with git status, quick open and find and replace
Integrated terminal, Markdown and HTML preview, and image viewing
Adaptive Adwaita interface with automatic light and dark styles
